use_case_summary: Primary workload: sub-100ms reranking & real-time personalization for web storefronts; embeddings for search and session stitching. High QPS with bursty traffic (seasonal sales).
technical_requirements: Steady-state throughput target: 600 req/s for full feature set (reranking + personalization)
Burst handling: up to 2,000 req/s for up to 15 minutes (seasonal peaks)
Latency SLOs: P95 < 180ms end-to-end for short prompts (<=64 tokens); P99 < 350ms
Reserved GPU plan: regional pools with warm standby; target nodes by region: us-east-1 -> 40 A100-equivalent GPUs, eu-west-1 -> 20, ap-southeast-1 -> 10
Failover headroom: 30% cross-region absorb capacity, 15% within-region cross-AZ headroom
Overcommit policy: allow up to 1.1x soft overprovision for non-latency-critical batch jobs; latency-critical routes must be pinned to reserved capacity
KV cache warming: pre-warm strategy required for hot prefixes; acceptable cold-starts <5 per minute during business hours
Autoscaling expectations: dedicated autoscale must respect reserved baseline and only burst into shared capacity with prior agreement
Fallbacks: automatic fallback to smaller model variant (quantized) for sustained overloads with documented quality delta
Observability: token-level latency breakdown, per-route QPS, and per-GPU utilization telemetry needed for monthly capacity reviews
